ITEM 1 | Pale orange cubes and wedges with smooth, slightly fibrous flesh and a matte surface, some with light tan edges, cut into irregular chunks about 2-3 cm, clustered in the upper left of the plate covering roughly 15% of the plate area, piled a few pieces high, firm and holding shape | 150
ITEM 2 | Small cherry tomatoes, glossy red with smooth skin, whole and halved-looking, about 2-2.5 cm each, nine or ten visible, arranged in a loose cluster in the center-left of the plate covering roughly 15% of the plate, single layer with slight overlap, firm and juicy-looking | 130
ITEM 3 | Half of a yellow squash, bright yellow skin with pale cream interior and visible seed cavity, about 7 cm across and 4 cm tall, cut face up, firm, dry-looking surface, sitting at the left edge of the tomato cluster | 110
ITEM 4 | White cauliflower florets, creamy white with slightly textured surface, small clusters about 2-4 cm across, a few tiny green-free stems, covering about 7% of the plate in the upper right, firm and dry-looking | 60
ITEM 5 | Orange carrot pieces, both thick rounds and long sticks, bright orange with a slightly glossy, matte-smooth surface, some with browned or caramelized edges, cut into 3-6 cm lengths and 1-2 cm thick, piled in a heap on the lower right covering about 15% of the plate, firm and holding shape | 130
